usage: Feat choice for chargen or level-up.

srd.text: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1. You have Advantage on Constitution saves to maintain Concentration. You can perform somatic components with weapons or a shield in hand. When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you, you can cast a single-target spell as the Reaction instead.
